summary: Curry County, OR lookout on Siskiyou NF land: built 1930, staffed summers into 1941, abandoned 1962 and removed. No source describes the summit today.

facts.design: Lookout building on a summit widened by blasting
facts.status_note: firelookout.com says gone; the Rex page marks it removed, with no date given

events.note: New lookout station built on Mount Butler in 1930, per 1930 newspaper items; firelookout.com dates the cabin to 1929
Earliest staffing in the sources read: Mr. and Mrs. Lawrence Brady planned to spend the summer on the lookout (June 30, 1933 item)
Mr. and Mrs. Howard Slonecker packed in to spend the summer at the lookout (July 9, 1936 item)
Lyle Nestle in charge of the lookout station for the summer (July 29, 1937 item)
Donald Slonecker replaced Dean Bundy for the remainder of the season (September 12, 1940 item)
Last staffing record on the Rex page: station staffed 65 days, reported to the Powers Ranger Station
Abandoned per firelookout.com; the same entry says gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com dates the cabin to 1929. Newspaper items from August to November 1930 describe the new station as being built that year. The story follows the dated newspaper items and notes the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: Siskiyou NF, status gone, ground. Build year is unresolved (1929 per firelookout.com, 1930 per newspapers); the story follows the newspapers. The 2939 ft elevation on firelookout.com is ground elevation, not tower height, so it is not used. Access is unknown and no current source was found. Two web searches found only unrelated sites (a Port Orford lifeboat tower, Snow Camp, Bolan Mountain and Butler Butte in Umpqua NF); none was used. Butler Butte is a different lookout and must not be merged.
